objectives.description: theory_lib/__init__.py registers theories lazily at import time
discover_theories demoted to dev lint; check_registry_drift added

approaches_tried.approach: eager get_theory() call per component lambda
approaches_tried.reason: would call get_theory() up to 4x per theory; switched to a shared per-theory cache dict across the four component loaders

deviations.description: theory_lib/__init__.py registers all four theories into the registry at import time
deviations.reason: Made _register_theories() idempotent (skip already-registered names) after observing pytest --import-mode=importlib re-execute theory_lib/__init__.py's top-level code in isolation while the registry module instance was not itself reloaded, which the registry's fail-fast duplicate check correctly rejected as a hard collection error for a single-file conformance test run.

deviations.description: Added registry.py to test_layering.py's CORE_SINGLE_FILES inventory
deviations.reason: registry.py is explicitly described as living in the core layer; including it in the layering test's file inventory keeps the test's own coverage accurate (zero-impact on violation counts).
